title: BloodRayne: ReVamped
synopsis: Terminal Reality’s 2002 dhampir action game, refreshed for consoles — retained as the Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.developer: Terminal Reality · ReVamped by Big Boat Interactive
catalog.publisher: Ziggurat Interactive · physical edition by Limited Run Games
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · Limited Run Games edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
BloodRayne introduced Rayne, a half-vampire agent fighting through the 1930s, in Terminal Reality’s third-person action game published by Majesco in October 2002.

Ziggurat Interactive brought it to consoles as BloodRayne: ReVamped, credited to Big Boat Interactive, on November 18, 2021 — the console counterpart of the 2020 PC Terminal Cut, with higher resolutions and improved effects. Limited Run Games produced the Switch physical edition as Switch Limited Run #126.

This filing opens the BloodRayne lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Switch Limited Run #126, Limited Run Games’ physical edition of BloodRayne: ReVamped.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Original release in October 2002 on PlayStation 2, Xbox, and GameCube. The PC Terminal Cut followed in 2020; BloodRayne: ReVamped released on consoles, including Nintendo Switch, on November 18, 2021. Limited Run Games issued the physical edition as Switch Limited Run #126.
preservation.availability: Limited Run Games’s physical edition was a limited production and now circulates through the secondary market. The digital Switch edition was issued separately on the Nintendo eShop.
